subject.title: feat(config): add compaction.thinkingLevel to override thinking level during compaction

question: Should OpenClaw add `agents.defaults.compaction.thinkingLevel` as a public configuration contract even though native Codex compaction cannot honor it?
rationale: The setting solves a demonstrated cost and token-control problem, but it expands an already large config surface and creates intentionally different behavior between embedded and native Codex compaction runtimes.

options.title: Sponsor and complete the contract
options.body: Approve the key, require full local-caller wiring, public runtime-scope documentation, and integration coverage before merge.

options.title: Keep existing compaction controls
options.body: Decline the new key and continue using model/provider selection until a runtime-neutral compaction policy surface is designed.
